item.description: Have you ever found yourself wanting a T-shirt that celebrates both Ohio State and Michigan? Today’s your lucky day. item.title: No. 2 Ohio State Comes From Behind to Beat No. 5 Iowa, 24-9, in Front of Record-Breaking Covelli Center Crowd
item.description: Two of Ohio State’s six all-time wins over Iowa have come this season. Before 2025-26, the Buckeyes were 4-44 against the Hawkeyes, but with a 27-12 win in November and a 24-9 win on Friday, Ohio State proved it belongs among the Big Ten's elite while improving to 17-0 for the first time in program history. The Buckeyes did it in front of a record-breaking crowd of 4,749 at the Covelli Center. Iowa controlled the opening matches by winning three straight decisions against Ohio State’s wrestlers.
